name: How long does a window lock repair typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a window lock repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard window lock repairs can be completed within one to three hours, depending on the complexity of the issue and the availability of replacement parts. If a specific part needs to be ordered, the repair might involve two visits: one for diagnosis and ordering, and another for installation. Our technicians strive for efficient service to minimize disruption to your day, often completing repairs on the first visit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most window lock repairs take 1-3 hours, but may require more time if specific parts need to be ordered.
